identity_check: Confirmed as Prometheus (formerly Project Prometheus; site prometheus.ai, linked from PYMNTS), the AI company co-led as co-CEOs by Jeff Bezos and Vik Bajaj (ex-Google X, Verily co-founder), launched in November 2025 with $6.2B and based in San Francisco with offices in London and Zurich. It is the same company whose June 2026 $12B round is recorded in bezos-expeditions.json: the same MarketScreener and Crypto Briefing pages were re-read here, and PYMNTS, Pulse 2.0 and SiliconANGLE describe the same co-CEOs and focus. Not Prometheus Group (enterprise asset-management / maintenance software), Prometheus Biosciences, Prometheus Fuels or the open-source Prometheus monitoring tool. Category set to adjacent (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 had remote): every page describes AI tools that help engineers design, prototype and prepare physical products for manufacturing (an 'artificial general engineer' for aerospace, automotive and computing), which overlaps Utopian's design-intent tooling for hardware teams; Crypto Briefing says it targets engineering workflows rather than robotics or factory automation, and Bezos says it is not building robots, so it does not touch plant-floor procurement, maintenance or WhatsApp agents. Layer design_intent rather than process_planning because the stated focus is design and pre-production engineering. No product or customer is public yet.

open_items: Company's own site (prometheus.ai) returned HTTP 429 twice; product description, leadership and offices come from press pages only. No company release about either round was found.
Nov 2025 $6.2B financing: series, exact close date and investors other than Jeff Bezos not found ('partly from Bezos' and 'other unnamed investors'). Dated to the 2025-11-17 launch reports.
Series B: MarketScreener mentions 'other investors' beyond those named; GeekWire, Axios, CNBC and Bloomberg coverage was 403 / paywalled and not read.

Wikipedia (citing Wired, 2025-11-26) says Prometheus acquired General Agents, an agentic-AI startup; an acquisition, not a funding round, and the Wired article was not read. The Decoder (citing FT) says Prometheus plans a holding company to buy businesses its AI could transform; size and status not found.
Headcount: about 100 at launch (SiliconANGLE, Nov 2025), over 120 in Dec 2025 (Wikipedia), about 150 in Jun 2026 (Crypto Briefing, PYMNTS, Pulse 2.0).
No customers, product, pricing or revenue public. Bezos said Blue Origin could benefit from its technology and that it may become an AWS customer; neither is a named customer.
Founding year 2025 from Wikipedia ('founded ... in November 2025'); some reports say work began earlier in 2025, not verified.
